claimsToVerify: Gladiator diets consisted primarily of barley, beans, and grains (giving them the nickname hordearii).
Gladiators received specialized medical care, famously including physicians like Galen at Pergamum.
Most gladiator fights did not end in fatal combat, as trained gladiators were expensive investments.
